title: Prisma with Server Actions
description: Perform type-safe mutations directly from React forms and components using Next.js Server Actions and revalidatePath.

data.text: **Server Actions** are asynchronous functions that execute on the server and can be invoked directly from Client or Server Components. Combined with Prisma, Server Actions allow writing seamless full-stack mutations without configuring API routes or managing boilerplate `fetch()` calls.

data.title: app/actions/create-post.ts
data.content: Server Action validating input, mutating database with Prisma, and invalidating Next.js cache.

data.title: Cache Revalidation with `revalidatePath`
data.text: After executing a database mutation with Prisma inside a Server Action, always call `revalidatePath('/your-route')` to immediately purge stale cached HTML and refresh the UI.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Server Actions marked with `'use server'` run strictly on the server.
Parse and validate incoming FormData with Zod before database insertion.
Use `revalidatePath()` or `revalidateTag()` to keep Server Components fresh.
